subject: Pricing request - bolts and motors
text:
Hey guys,

Can you send me pricing on the following:
- 10 boxes of 1/2-13 x 2" grade 8 hex cap screws, yellow zinc
- 10 boxes of matching grade 8 1/2-13 nuts
- 10 boxes 1/2" hardened flat washers
- 2x 5HP 3-phase TEFC motors, 184T frame, 1800rpm

Need everything in two weeks. Ship to Delta Fab Works, 1200 Industrial Pkwy, Tulsa, OK 74107.

Thanks!
Maria
Delta Fab Works | 918-555-0199
